turns.content: I want 6000 euros to buy my car

For your car purchase (6 000 €), the suitable product is the **Expresso Auto Loan**: it is an amortising loan allocated to buying a vehicle, with an indicative APR of 4.99% (it depends on your file and the term, it is not a guaranteed rate). It is available from 1 000 €, with no compulsory down payment, adjustable monthly payments and possible early repayment.

**Affordability verdict:** your situation appears broadly affordable. Your current debt-to-income ratio is 20% (956 €/month of existing loan), your average savings capacity is around 928 €/month and you have 14 695 € of savings. One point to watch, however: your current account balance is low (1 517 €) and an overdraft has already been observed, so an additional monthly payment must remain moderate to protect your remaining income.

**Next step:** to obtain a personalised estimate of your monthly payment and the total cost, use the official simulator: [URL|Simulate my Expresso Auto Loan|https://particuliers.sg.fr/emprunter/credit-auto-deux-roues/credit-auto-expresso]

Would you like to specify the term you are considering, or look at using part of your savings to reduce the amount borrowed?
